title: Deeper/broader PAR-139 field integrity, inversion metadata, and peer XCLIP evidence
mode: Primary-source documentation and source review plus local plan reconciliation
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Reconcile local SPATIAL_FILTER DXF and DWG layouts with the ODA v5.4.1 specification and Autodesk's DXF/API documentation.
Audit peer implementation/release evidence for front clipping, inversion, matrix parsing, and WCS path conversion.
Refine existing PAR-139 field admission, owner graph, generated regression matrix, and optional comparator limits without adding another feature finding.

sources.name: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1, §20.4.94 SPATIAL_FILTER
sources.observed: The DWG object body is point count and repeated 2D points; extrusion and clip-boundary origin; display/front/back flags; conditional front/back distances; two 12-value 4x3 matrices; then common parent/reactor/extension-dictionary handles. The section does not define a separate inversion boolean in this object layout.

sources.name: Autodesk SPATIAL_FILTER DXF reference, SpatialFilterDefinition.Enabled, and XCLIP command documentation
sources.observed: The DXF schema defines the repeated 40-value distance/matrix contexts and conditional clipping planes. The managed Enabled property describes making the clip volume effective versus all of 3D space, while the XCLIPFRAME system variable controls boundary frame display/plotting. Autodesk also documents multiple instances of the same external reference with distinct clip boundaries.

sources.name: ezdxf SpatialFilter and XClip source/documentation
sources.observed: Current source obtains matrices from the final 24 group-40 values and writes the optional front distance only when the front-clip flag is enabled. Experimental inverted paths use ACAD_XREC_ROUNDTRIP XRECORD sections; source/docs say the path structure is not fully understood and warn that AutoCAD will not load DXF files authored with this inverted-path form. This creates an additional filter-owned extension dictionary/XRECORD preservation edge, not a proven portable inversion representation.

sources.name: IxMilia.Dxf release history and ezdxf XCLIP issue
sources.observed: IxMilia.Dxf 0.8.4 lists a front-clipping-plane handling fix. Open ezdxf issue #1305 reports a WCS clipping path different from the CAD application's displayed coordinates for an attached sample. Neither report reproduces a libdxfrw defect; together they justify explicit front-plane and transformed-coordinate controls and prohibit using ezdxf as the sole geometry oracle.

sources.name: Local libdxfrw source and test audit
localReferences: src/drw_objects.cpp:19198-19253 (DXF parser accepts partial group-40 state; front distance assignment is deferred until matrix count reaches 24)
src/libdxfrw.cpp:23201-23232 (typed writer zero-fills absent matrix vector values)
dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp and dwg2dxf/dx_data.h (no SPATIAL_FILTER callback storage/raw route)
tests/hardening_tests.cpp:1631-1649 (current 25-value parser-state copy/reset test, not schema validation)
sources.observed: The typed parser accepts fewer than 24 group-40 values without matrix completion; a single front distance does not reach the existing assignment. The writer substitutes zero for missing matrix elements. Existing tests only establish parser-state reset/copy with an arbitrary 25-value stream, while the adapter independently drops the typed and raw callback.

assessment.planImpact: PAR-139 now starts with flag-aware strict typed-field validation before adapter replay: exactly 24 group-40 matrix values with front clipping off, exactly 25 with it on (distance followed by 24 matrix values), finite values, 0/1 flags, and point-count consistency. The full owner closure includes an optional filter-owned extension dictionary/XRECORD for opaque inversion metadata. Generated tests cover front/back conditions, clip-volume enablement separately from XCLIPFRAME, and two INSERTs sharing one block but owning different filters. ezdxf is secondary-only for declared 2D paths; native and semantic qualification remain composed-gate work.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source documentation/source review, local source/test inspection, and plan editing
method.limitations: The ezdxf issue is an unresolved reporter claim and its attachment was not fetched or inspected. The IxMilia changelog is a historical release disclosure, not a current executable result. Mutable peer source/docs are comparator design evidence, not normative authority. Autodesk DXF schema and the local ODA §20.4.94 PDF remain the primary format references. No support, rendering, inversion, or native-CAD claim is promoted.
